    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits src/policy/policy.cpp and src/policy/policy.h to deduplicate policy checks that transition into consensus rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Policy edits follow directly from the consensus validation specification rather than altering mempool policy behavior independently."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/node/miner.cpp minimally (+3/-3) to adjust coinbase locktime to height minus one in compliance with the new consensus rule.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The block assembler modification is a mechanical follow-on required by the BIP 54 consensus rule."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test/functional/p2p_segwit.py solely to update test transaction fixtures to conform to BIP 54 rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not touch P2P networking, protocol messages, transport, or peer management."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/blockchain.cpp (+1/-0) solely to reflect versionbits deployment info.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Reporting deployment info in getblockchaininfo is mechanical plumbing rather than an RPC interface change."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "New fuzz harnesses, unit tests, and functional test files specifically target BIP 54 validation logic rather than general test framework infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests pinning the behavior of a specific functional area belong to that area rather than test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements BIP 54 consensus validation rules across block headers and transaction verification in src/validation.cpp and src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Implements the BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules to resolve long-standing consensus vulnerabilities including timewarp difficulty manipulation, Merkle tree leaf-node collisions (CVE-2017-12842), and legacy sigops validation CPU exhaustion. Enabling the rules exclusively on regtest provides substantial, durable value for evaluating the consensus changes in the repository while intentionally deferring mainnet activation."
    },
